target.name: WISE 0855-0714
target.epoch_note: The position given in the challenge brief, used verbatim. It is from 2010-era WISE data and WISE 0855 is too cold for Gaia, so it is not carried forward.

reason: WISE 0855-0714 is not at the centre of this view, so the source there is not it. The coldest brown dwarf known, about -23 C. The brief's position is from 2010; by 2025 it has moved 2 arcmin west (right of centre), to within 8 arcsec of a brighter star that SPHEREx's 6-arcsec pixels cannot cleanly separate from it.
